dedupe_keys.name: sub saharan africa electrification grid preparation code

description: The Electrification_SSA_data GitHub repository publishes the analysis scripts behind a Scientific Data electrification grid for sub-Saharan Africa. Its README describes a Google Earth Engine JavaScript stage, an R stage and supporting geographic files. The workflow can reproduce or adapt gridded estimates of electricity access before they are used as demand or service-coverage inputs in an infrastructure simulation. Reproducing the original workflow requires external settlement layers and Earth Engine access; the README also mentions a LandScan account for one population input, with public alternatives. The published Mendeley output grids are a separate data resource, so a modeller can use those without running this code. GitHub reports GPL-3.0. I read own repository metadata and README but did not request Earth Engine access, clone the repository or run the scripts. No exact catalogue record was found. It is a companion to the separately reviewed Mendeley output grids; the code and published estimates have different licences.
